text:
The Parasite Tree’s Of Skinwalker Ranch. 

Seedance 2 Prompt - 

Nightmare creature island. Dense jungle filled with towering dead-looking trees. Gray bark, twisted branches, hanging moss, strange glowing sacs attached to trunks. Thick fog rolls across the forest floor. Everything appears lifeless—but something is wrong. Hyper-real creature-feature action. Aggressive handheld cinematography, rapid cut-tos, whip pans, crash zooms, speed ramps. Sound: crocodile roars, snapping branches, parasite screeches, survivor breathing.

⸻

0–2s — HOOK

Handheld chase shot.

A survivor is already sprinting through the forest.

Branches whip past the lens.

Behind him—

A gigantic mega crocodile explodes through the trees.

Forty feet long.

Ancient scars.

Massive jaws snapping shut inches behind him.

Entire saplings are flattened as it charges.

⸻

2–5s — ESCALATION

Side tracking shot.

The survivor zigzags between dead trees.

The crocodile bulldozes straight through them.

Wood splinters everywhere.

The beast is gaining rapidly.

The survivor glances ahead—

A strange grove of giant gray trees.

No leaves.

No movement.

⸻

5–8s — FALSE SAFETY

The survivor enters the grove.

Everything becomes eerily quiet.

The crocodile follows.

Then—

One glowing pod hanging from a tree suddenly bursts.

A glowing parasite lands on the crocodile’s back.

The crocodile barely reacts.

Then another pod bursts.

And another.

⸻

8–11s — REVEAL

Crash zoom.

Dozens of parasites attach themselves to the crocodile.

The creature begins mutating almost instantly.

A second jaw tears through its neck.

Extra eyes open along its body.

New limbs push through its sides.

The crocodile becomes larger.

More aggressive.

More horrifying.

⸻

11–13s — CHAOS

The survivor thinks he’s dead.

Then every tree in the grove awakens.

Thousands of parasite pods burst simultaneously.

The air fills with glowing organisms.

They swarm the mutated crocodile.

The creature continues mutating uncontrollably.

More limbs.

More mouths.

More eyes.

Its body can’t handle it.

⸻

13–15s — SHOCKING PAYOFF

The crocodile suddenly splits apart.

Not exploding—

Separating.

Two different mutated crocodile creatures emerge from the same body.

Both immediately attack each other.

The survivor watches in disbelief.

Then one of the “dead” trees slowly opens a gigantic eye in its trunk.

Hard cut to black.

Aggressive handheld cinematography, rapid cut-tos, whip pans, crash zooms, speed ramps. Sound: crocodile roars, snapping branches, parasite screeches, survivor breathing.

translations.es: Isla de criaturas de pesadilla. Jungla densa llena de árboles altos que parecen muertos. Corteza gris, ramas retorcidas, musgo colgante, extraños sacos luminosos adheridos a los troncos. Una densa niebla se extiende por el suelo del bosque. Todo parece sin vida, pero algo está mal. Acción hiperrealista de criaturas. Cinematografía agresiva con cámara en mano, cortes rápidos, whip pans, crash zooms, speed ramps. Sonido: rugidos de cocodrilo, ramas quebrándose, chillidos de parásitos, respiración de supervivientes.
translations.fr:
---
Île des créatures cauchemardesques. Jungle dense remplie d'arbres imposants à l'apparence morte. Écorce grise, branches tordues, mousse pendante, sacs lumineux étranges attachés aux troncs. Un épais brouillard se répand sur le sol de la forêt. Tout semble sans vie—mais quelque chose ne va pas. Action hyper-réaliste de créatures. Cinématographie agressive à la caméra à main, coupes rapides, whip pans, crash zooms, speed ramps. Son : rugissements de crocodiles, branches qui craquent, cris de parasites, respiration de survivants.
translations.ja:
---
ナイトメアクリーチャーアイランド。密集したジャングルには、そびえ立つ死んだような木々が立ち並ぶ。灰色の樹皮、ねじれた枝、垂れ下がる苔、幹に付着した奇妙な光る袋。濃い霧が森の床を覆う。すべてが生命を失ったように見えるが、何かがおかしい。ハイパーリアルなクリーチャーフィーチャーアクション。アグレッシブなハンドヘルド撮影、急速なカット、ウィップパン、クラッシュズーム、スピードランプ。音響：ワニの咆哮、折れる枝、寄生虫の悲鳴、生存者の呼吸。
translations.ko:
---
악몽의 생물 섬. 거대한 죽은 나무들로 가득한 울창한 정글. 회색 나무껍질, 뒤틀린 가지, 늘어진 이끼, 나무줄기에 붙어 있는 이상한 빛나는 주머니들. 짙은 안개가 숲 바닥을 가로질러 흐른다. 모든 것이 생명 없는 것처럼 보이지만, 뭔가 잘못되었다. 하이퍼 리얼 생물 액션. 공격적인 핸드헬드 시네마토그래피, 빠른 컷 투, 휩 팬, 크래시 줌, 스피드 램프. 소리: 악어의 포효, 부러지는 가지, 기생충의 비명, 생존자의 숨소리.
translations.pt-BR: Ilha de criaturas de pesadelo. Selva densa repleta de árvores altas com aparência morta. Casca cinza, galhos retorcidos, musgo pendurado, estranhos sacos luminosos presos aos troncos. Névoa espessa se espalha pelo chão da floresta. Tudo parece sem vida—mas algo está errado. Ação hiper-real de criaturas. Cinematografia agressiva com câmera na mão, cortes rápidos, whip pans, crash zooms, speed ramps. Som: rugidos de crocodilo, galhos quebrando, guinchos de parasitas, respiração de sobreviventes.
translations.zh-CN:
---
梦魇生物岛。茂密的丛林中充满了高耸的死寂树木。灰色树皮，扭曲的树枝，悬挂的苔藓，奇异的发光囊附着在树干上。浓雾在森林地面上滚动。一切看起来都毫无生气——但有什么不对劲。超现实生物特写动作。激进的手持摄影，快速切换，whip pans，crash zooms，speed ramps。声音：鳄鱼咆哮，树枝断裂声，寄生虫尖叫声，幸存者的呼吸声。
